filters.BILLING: Only bug reports about billing: invoices, charges, payments, refunds or checkout. Ignore feature requests.
filters.DOCS: Only requests to fix or improve documentation, such as the README, guides or API reference.
filters.SECURITY: Only reports of a security vulnerability or an exposed secret.
filters.PACKET: Only messages announcing that a review packet was unlocked, which means QA is complete. The wording varies.
filters.MOBILE: Only customer-reported bugs in the mobile app. Ignore questions and feature requests.
filters.INCIDENT: Only reports of a production outage or incident that is affecting customers now.
